listing.description: Nestled in the highly sought-after Piedmont Pines, this meticulously rebuilt three-bedroom, two-bathroom residence is surrounded by a serene redwood setting, seamlessly blending modern luxury with thoughtful craftsmanship and open living spaces. Reconstructed from the foundation and framing, the home boasts a brand-new kitchen, bathrooms, plumbing, and roof, complemented by high-quality materials and contemporary finishes throughout. Approximately 450 SF of extra space beyond the main residence offers endless possibilities for a home office, creative studio, fitness area, or storage. For 3D and virual tour, please visit the property website; https://6773wiltondr.com. Open House; October 10th & 11th. from 2:00 to 4:30pm. Offers by Oct. 14th. 2:00pm.

view.note: MLS itself declares view: None; living-level outlooks are dense redwood canopy + a distant-hill sliver (p_21, p_25), no bay/water anywhere incl. drone top-down (p_61)

natural_light.note: Vaulted glass walls, >=4 skylights, big sun patches across living/dining/den (p_08, p_14, p_16, p_31); lower-level rooms dimmer with high windows (p_62-63)

character.note: White-painted post-and-beam T&G vaults, angular clerestory transoms, glass walls, board-form concrete entry wall — MCM-lite done well (p_08, p_23-24, p_06)

kitchen.note: All-new: flat-panel oak + glass uppers, quartz, 36in 6-burner pro gas range w/ SS hood, handmade-look clay tile to ceiling, island, butler pantry, skylight (p_30-35)

privacy.note: Uphill 3-story neighbor overlooks courtyard + breakfast nook ~25-35 ft (p_03, p_07, p_37, p_60); second neighbor close on far side (p_61); BR2 faces fence (p_42)

layout_flow.note: True open plan living-dining-kitchen axis with sliders to both courtyard and rear deck (p_13, p_16-19); interior stair to lower suite + bonus (p_46)

primary_suite.note: Bright corner-window primary on main level into tree canopy (p_38-40); no clearly en-suite bath visible in photos — verify adjacency

outdoor_space.note: Four usable zones: entry courtyard w/ fountain (p_01, p_28), rear composite deck (p_18-19), terraced garden paths (p_29), downslope fire-pit pad (p_51-53)

condition.note: Foundation-up rebuild: new comp roof, windows, plumbing, kitchens/baths (p_06, p_59); garage open-rafter unfinished and raw workshop under house (p_57, p_64)

lot_usability.note: 0.17 AC hillside: patios/paths are usable but much of the lot is planted slope w/ canopy (p_52-56); no flat lawn; upkeep + defensible-space burden

verdict: This is a tree-house, not a view house: a genuinely high-quality foundation-up contemporary rebuild buried in redwood canopy in Piedmont Pines, trading any bay view and real privacy (an uphill 3-story neighbor stares into the courtyard and breakfast nook) for exceptional natural light, open-beam MCM character, and a best-in-class new kitchen. At $1.099M ($643/sf) after a $812K purchase one year ago, you are paying retail for someone else's well-executed rebuild — worth it only if light, character, and turnkey condition outrank views, privacy, and the Very High FHSZ insurance reality of the Oakland hills.
flags: 🔥 Very High FHSZ (presumptive) — Piedmont Pines 94611 sits in the 1991 Oakland firestorm footprint; insurance availability/cost must be quoted BEFORE offer (FAIR Plan risk)
🌲 Redwood canopy directly overhangs the roof and a wood/composite deck on tall posts sits over a dry vegetated slope (p_51, p_53-56) — defensible-space and ember-resistance workload
👁️ Uphill 3-story shingle neighbor overlooks the entry courtyard, breakfast nook, and garden from ~25-35 ft (p_03, p_07, p_60); BR2 window faces a fence (p_42)
🛏️ 3rd bedroom + ~450 SF 'extra space' are lower level, partially below grade, part raw workshop (p_62-64); permit status unknown — verify before counting square footage
🏚️ Garage interior is open-rafter unfinished (p_57) despite 'meticulously rebuilt' marketing; street asphalt cracked (p_58)
⛰️ House sits below street grade on a hillside; 4+ skylights on the new low-slope comp roof (p_59-60) to keep sealed in fire country
positives: ✨ Foundation-up rebuild per listing: new roof, plumbing, kitchen, baths, windows (verify permits) — effectively new construction in a vintage shell
🌞 Exceptional main-level natural light: vaulted glass walls, clerestory transoms, 4+ skylights, sun patches in nearly every shot
🌲 Immersive redwood-canopy outlooks from living, dining, den, and primary bedroom — true tree-house feel despite no vista
🍳 Kitchen is a genuine quality build: 36in pro gas range w/ vented SS hood, clay tile to ceiling, island, butler pantry (p_30-35)
🪴 Four distinct outdoor rooms — courtyard, deck, fountain terrace, fire-pit pad — unusually good indoor-outdoor flow for the price band
📍 Piedmont Pines at ~1,448 ft, 14 DOM, below-street setback keeps road noise out; honest listing (MLS view field says 'None')
orientationInference: Entry/courtyard side faces ~W-SW — dusk shots (p_03, p_65) show sunset glow through trees over the garage, and afternoon sun floods the living room through the courtyard sliders (p_08, p_10); the glass-wall den/deck side faces the downslope canyon ~E-NE for morning light. Everything tree-filtered. Inference.
